packageRules.description: GoReleaser pin in release-publish.yml: the goreleaser-action `version:` input is compared as a bare string against the org-wide REQUIRED_GORELEASER_VERSION (a bare version such as 2.19.0), but goreleaser/goreleaser tags are v-prefixed and Renovate writes the tag name. extractVersion strips the v so the pin stays bare.

customManagers.description: git-cliff pin: GIT_CLIFF_VERSION in mise.toml, the one place the version is written. scripts/release/install-git-cliff.sh reads it from there, so ci.yml, `mise run verify` and both shared release workflows all install the version this line names, and the script verifies the release signature against a pinned key. The signing-key fingerprint lives in the script, never on a line this manager rewrites.
